verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own day-one business bank account, provided through Increase Bank, and a Money Dashboard showing cash balance, inflows and outflows in the same product as payroll, so the banking leg of consolidation is covered. However, these capabilities are in early beta. Spend and bill pay are only approximated by adjacent features: allowance-based reimbursements run alongside payroll, and invoice ingestion prefills contractor paysheets. There is no general vendor bill pay or spend-management/corporate-card evidence. missing for 10: general vendor bill pay, corporate card or spend controls, generally available banking beyond early beta, independent hands-on corroboration of consolidation.
